values.note: Every site has electric: $37 a night, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); $33 off-peak (November 2026, January 2027). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 38 Guilford Lake campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Fee 6.50); site 002 on Sat 2027-06-19 (37.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (33.00), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 38 web-bookable electric sites; 35 carry ReserveOhio's trailer icon and are rated for camping units 24-85 ft (three pull-throughs, 39-41, at 85 ft); 007, 008 and 033 carry a tent icon and no length. ODNR counts 40 electric sites. Pets permitted on all sites.

values.note: Seasonal camp office sells supplies, firewood, ice and concessions; separate beach for registered campers, fishing dock, kayak and paddleboat rentals, boat docks first come, first served.

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to May 1: portable toilets and the dump station only, no water. ReserveOhio sells all 38 sites in November, January and April.

Water is not available.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 449 for 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13 (all 38 free), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'There are no walk-in campsites; all are reservable online.' 'Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

note: West and south rows of sites front Guilford Lake with boat docks at the shoreline. NOTE: ODNR is rehabilitating the dam. The lake has been drawn down about 20 ft since early 2026 and the work site is closed to the public; refilling is expected to start in winter 2026/27 and finish in spring 2027, weather dependent. The campground remains open (ODNR update 6/10/26). --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed ($37, all electric) and added $33 off-peak. Added 50-amp electric, 35 RV sites to 85 ft with 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump/camp store, year-round with the no-water off-peak rule, ReserveOhio deep link, no walk-ins, 6-month window, 14-night max. Note: dropped '(all-electric)' (hookups now says it) and updated the drawdown line from ODNR's dam project page (refill winter 2026/27 to spring 2027; campground open). Not in status: the campground is open.
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page lists (330) 222-1688 (the seasonal camp office); the park office on the park page is (330) 222-1712.
Pin 280 m off (99 m from the nearest site; it sits south-east among the private cottages beside the park). Centroid of ReserveOhio's 38 site coordinates: 40.80660,-80.87773.

Waterfront (stored lakefront), the brief's question on the west/south rows: on imagery with ReserveOhio's site coordinates plotted, the south row (010-015) sits on a wooded bank 20-40 m above the shore, west of the campers' beach; 011 sits just behind the beach; the eastern row 002-006 is under trees 35-50 m from the waterline across grass and the beach, beside the docks. The north loops (014-041) are 100+ m from the water. So 'front the lake' holds at best for a handful of the 35 RV sites (south row; the beach is a strip between some of them and the water) - a re-audit lead, not a verdict. ODNR says only 'The inviting campground features lake views'. The lake itself is drawn down about 20 ft until spring 2027.
